theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_hausdorff_upper_integral_of_ne_top
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → μH[((m + k : ℕ) : ℝ)] A ≠ ∞ → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μH[(k : ℝ)] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn m) 1) * (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * μH[((m + k : ℕ) : ℝ)] A
